items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: We became great friends. He wants to adopt me. He wants me to be like his nephew. And I'm supposed to call him Uncle Bill.

ctx.x: Bojangles Robinson, how we became friends. He asked me, he says, "I like you. I like the way you talk. Who are you? Who is your father? Who is your mother? Who is your sister? Who is your brother? Where are you from? Do you play pool?" Said, "Seems like I know you." "What do they call you?" So I told him, "Well, they used to call me Shorty." I said, "I remember you from that night at the gaming room." He laughed and said, "Oh, yeah. You was that pool shooter there's partner. You was with this same man that was…

know." So we did. Now, when we gets there, he said, "I'll tell you what. We'll play a," -- he said, "I like the way you tap dance you know. I was looking for you to do some of my tap dance, but I noticed I didn't see any," he said. "But I like the way you tap dance." He said, "I'll tell you, we'll play pool, say, whatever ball that we pocket, that's how many tap steps you'd have to do." So I said, "Yes, sir. Well, what are we going to call the game?" And he said, "We'll call it New America." So I did. I loved his…

remained friends, but as I said, the show was only playing there, he was only appearing a week, he was there with us. He was on a personal appearance tour, so we done that week together. Like to have got held over, you see, but the show had to move on. Happy go lucky from there.
